$comment: Item 105. One entry per rule file shipped under .claude/rules/. 'enforcedBy' lists shipped hooks that back the rule; each needs a 'probe' (a test in this repository that exercises the hook) or an explicit 'gap' saying why not yet. Rules with no hook are enforced by instruction and review only. Checked by scripts/check-governance.js.

ai-coding-rules.md.prevents: Unverified claims about code, skipped plans for multi-step work, unverified 'done', stubs and half-implementations

api-standards.md.prevents: Inconsistent endpoints, envelopes, status codes, pagination and async job contracts
api-standards.md.appliesWhen: Editing routes, controllers, handlers or OpenAPI files

branching-rules.md.prevents: Commits on dev or main, illegal merge paths, AI attribution trailers
branching-rules.md.appliesWhen: Editing CI, hooks, branch-protection setup or .gitattributes

coding-standards.md.prevents: Layer violations, hidden dependencies, magic values and silent failures

compliance-rules.md.prevents: Personal-data processing without lawful basis, retention or protection, when a compliance scope applies
compliance-rules.md.appliesWhen: Editing source or migrations in a project whose compliance scope is not N/A

security-rules.md.prevents: SQL injection, secrets in code, PII leaks, missing authentication or authorization, cross-tenant access

testing-rules.md.prevents: Untested changes, missing failure and authorization cases, flaky tests
testing-rules.md.appliesWhen: Editing test files or test configuration

ux-rules.md.prevents: Hardcoded colours, undefined states, desktop-only workflows

stacks/backend-node.md.prevents: Stack-specific defects in Node.js and TypeScript code

stacks/frontend-react.md.prevents: Component, state and accessibility defects in React code
